text: Machine learning is a type of technology that helps computers learn from information without being told exactly what to do. One common method is supervised learning, where a computer studies training data that already has correct answers. From this data, the computer builds models, which are like rules it can use later. After training, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it might predict whether an email is spam or not. We then check the model's accuracy by comparing its predictions with the real answers. The more accurate the model, the more useful it is in everyday life.
